name: io.github.nikicat/mcp-wallet-signer
title: EVM + TRON Wallet Signer
description: Non-custodial MCP server that routes EVM (MetaMask/Rabby via EIP-6963) and TRON (TronLink) transactions to browser wallets for signing. Private keys never leave the browser — every transaction requires explicit user approval.

environmentVariables.name: EVM_MCP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: HTTP server port for the EVM browser approval UI (default: 3847)

environmentVariables.name: EVM_MCP_DEFAULT_CHAIN
environmentVariables.description: Default EVM chain ID (default: 1 for Ethereum mainnet)

environmentVariables.name: TRON_MCP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: HTTP server port for the TRON browser approval UI (default: 3848)

environmentVariables.name: TRON_MCP_DEFAULT_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: Default TRON network: mainnet, shasta, or nile (default: mainnet)
